guidance.heading: Outlook for 2026 and 2027
section: DTE Energy confirms 2026 operating EPS guidance of $7.59 to $7.73. DTE Energy also provided a 2027 operating EPS pro forma baseline2 range of $7.59 - $7.73, which reflects the DTE Vantage asset sale.

“Strong financial performance through the third quarter of 2026 positions us to continue investing in Michigan’s energy infrastructure while delivering long-term value for our customers, communities and shareholders,” said David Ruud, DTE vice chairman and CFO.
Advisors to DTE Vantage Transaction Lazard is acting as exclusive financial advisor to DTE Energy, and Kirkland & Ellis LLP is acting as legal advisor to DTE Energy.

Footnote (1): Includes the sale of primarily all DTE Vantage assets, except EES Coke Footnote (2): Reflective of closing the Vantage transaction by year-end 2026 and is subject to change based on impacts from discontinued operations, actual closing timing and the timing of deployment of sale proceeds
This earnings announcement and presentation slides are available at dteenergy.com/investors.
